Package io.micronaut.data.jdql

Interface JDQLListener

All Superinterfaces:
org.antlr.v4.runtime.tree.ParseTreeListener
All Known Implementing Classes:
JDQLBaseListener
public interface JDQLListener extends org.antlr.v4.runtime.tree.ParseTreeListener
This interface defines a complete listener for a parse tree produced by JDQLParser.
